target_user: hotel operator importing a Ctrip legacy order export into SUXIOS revenue analysis
user_task: polish the completed Ctrip legacy XLS upload, aggregation, exact readback, and revenue-analysis loop

business_boundaries.hotel: explicitly selected system_hotel_id; local acceptance uses hotel 80 only
business_boundaries.tenant: resolved from the selected hotel and authenticated user scope
business_boundaries.business_date: stay date with an explicit booking-date fallback
business_boundaries.metric_scope: OTA channel order aggregates, not whole-hotel revenue
business_boundaries.persistence: manual-import source plus task-scoped value-level exact readback
business_boundaries.allowed_writes: scoped source code, tests, eval artifact, and local explicit-fixture records
non_goals: claiming real Ctrip-file acceptance without a real export

internal_baseline.deterministic_result: 4 PHPUnit tests / 43 assertions and 1 Node contract passed
internal_baseline.capability_limit: the .xls path forces the BIFF Xls reader and rejects a content-identified HTML table carrying an .xls filename

external_benchmark.applies: content identification can be restricted to an allowed reader subset; XML readers reject declared entities by default
external_benchmark.does_not_prove: that a real Ctrip export uses HTML content

external_benchmark.source: PhpSpreadsheet Reading and Writing to File
external_benchmark.applies: legacy .xls uploads may contain either BIFF data or HTML markup saved with an .xls extension
external_benchmark.does_not_prove: field compatibility with an unavailable real Ctrip file

external_benchmark.applies: server-side extension allowlist, content-type validation, size limits, authorization, and non-trusting of client Content-Type
external_benchmark.does_not_prove: antivirus or production upload infrastructure readiness

primary_user_value.dimension: legacy XLS compatibility without truth or privacy regression
primary_user_value.measurement: accepted safe fixture formats out of two: BIFF XLS and HTML-table-as-XLS
primary_user_value.material_delta: candidate must reach 2/2 while all hard gates and regression tests pass

hard_gates: only Xls and Html readers may be selected for an .xls upload
unsupported or malformed content fails closed with HTTP-semantics 422 and no server-path disclosure
system_hotel_id, platform, business date, and manual-unverified provenance remain explicit
raw order number, guest name, phone, and source filename are not persisted or returned
no real OTA write, external send, production release, commit, or push
capability_set: BIFF XLS fixture parses aliases and produces expected channel/date aggregates
HTML-table-as-XLS fixture is content-identified through the Html reader and produces the same PII-free aggregate contract
source format is preserved as aggregate provenance without persisting the source filename
malformed or unsupported .xls content returns a stable sanitized failure
regression_set: missing required Ctrip headers fail closed
canonical non-Ctrip rows pass through unchanged
duplicate orders remain deduplicated by latest notification time
cancelled orders do not enter active room nights or reference bottom price
manual-order rows do not become confirmed OTA room revenue
frontend closure contract and template gates remain green
explicit local fixture HTTP upload, persistence, exact readback, and Revenue AI overview remain green

grader_split.deterministic: reader allowlist, fixture outputs, privacy absence, exact readback, status semantics, PHPUnit/Node/template/HTTP commands
grader_split.llm_judge: whether the compatibility change is minimal, comprehensible, and aligned with the frozen user value after deterministic gates pass

maturity_target: integration_pass; comparative_pass only if the frozen 1/2 to 2/2 deterministic format delta repeats with zero hard-gate or regression failures; field_validated remains unavailable
stop_conditions: all deterministic gates pass and blind review returns PASS/READY
two rounds produce no measurable delta
the same maximum gap repeats three times
benchmark invalidation or reviewer isolation failure
a real-file, production, credential, or external authorization boundary is reached
evidence_limits: no real Ctrip order export is present in project scope
HTML-table-as-XLS compatibility is benchmark-derived and fixture-validated, not field-validated
Gauntlet v2 itself is an engineering protocol, not proof of product quality
